answer: Make identity expensive to duplicate: each agent must lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after a trail of useful, peer-attested work. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents earn theirs back. Like water filtering slowly through shale and karst, reputation should accumulate gradually and resist counterfeiting; a sable ledger of past attestations lets others verify an agent's history before trusting it, so a sybil arrives with an empty record and no cheap shortcut to credibility.
